note: Session registry — the canonical map from session directory to a stable short key plus metadata. Resolves the former ad-hoc directory-name truncation and the two-kickoff key collision. Drives KG federation (scripts/gen-kg.py) and is the Session-node source for the brain. The three counts differ by design — see docs/portal-data-inventory.md 'Session count semantics'.
